source_inferred: For codex rust-v0.166.0 commit 6ff1e1ca3b30fc8b914720681fcf5fe62e95f856, workspace routing discovery calls BackendClient::get_accounts_check; built-in ChatGPT configuration resolves to https://chatgpt.com/backend-api/wham/accounts/check.

The 15-second routing-discovery timeout would emit workspace routing discovery timed out, not the generic discovery failure. A 401 would emit DiscoveryUnauthorized. Thus the visible generic error excludes those two categories.

get_accounts_check's first five-second request failure is deliberately discarded before a system-proxy fallback request; if the fallback fails, the specific status/transport details are not propagated to the JSONL error.

recovery_conditions: Restore the externally managed proxy so HTTP(S) port 7890 and control port 9090 respond; do not rotate account, region, model, or credentials for this experiment.

Through the restored proxy, verify the actual routing category without treating chatgpt.com front-page success, model catalog success, or the old preflight as proof. The definitive acceptance is still a newly authorized real CLI turn reaching turn.completed.

After external routing appears healthy, a future restart requires a new explicit user authorization. It must continue this experiment's ledger: CLI 1/1 used, check 0/10, candidate 0/2, simulation 0/2; the unused simulations do not authorize a new CLI.
